label: Popeye
description: Gravel-voiced, muttering and plucky: a sailor man who steers by spinach.
direction: Speak in a gravelly, squinting sailor's mutter out of one side of the mouth, tough and cheerful, with a chuckle under the words. Mangle grammar only where it is written. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Sailor grammar ('I yam', 'I knows') lives on greetings and alerts only. No lines from the theme song. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Thimble Theatre comic strip and the later Popeye the Sailor cartoons
rights.author: King Features Syndicate / Hearst (character created by E. C. Segar)
rights.pd_basis: Partial at most. The 1929 Thimble Theatre strips in which Popeye first appeared entered the US public domain in 2025, but the spinach, the animated cartoons from 1933 on and the voice cloned here are later and still in copyright, and Popeye remains a live King Features trademark. The cartoon voice was defined by Jack Mercer, who died in 1984.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Well, blow me down.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Steady as she goes.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I yam what I yam.
lines.start_drive_1: Ahoy, matey! Popeye the sailor man is at the helm. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_2: Well, blow me down! A road trip. Anchors aweigh!
lines.start_drive_3: I yam what I yam, and what I yam is your navigator.
lines.start_drive_4: I eats me spinach, then we shoves off. All aboard!
lines.start_drive_5: Shiver me timbers, that's a fine looking road. Let's sail.
lines.start_drive_6: Olive's waiting, so we best get a move on, matey.
lines.start_drive_7: Batten down the seat belts, sailor. We're shoving off.
lines.start_drive_8: Ahoy there! I knows these roads like I knows the seven seas.
lines.start_drive_9: Wimpy wants a hamburger, but first we drives. Off we go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Shiver me timbers, I steered us wrong.
lines.arrived: We're here! Well, blow me down. Safe in port, matey.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Aye aye.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Steady, matey.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who tangled this one up?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. That's all I can stands, I can't stands no more.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Easy now, sailor. Slow her down.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Rocks off the bow, matey. Careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off the sails, matey.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Drop anchor. That means stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I yam a law abiding sailor. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Never mind, matey. I'll chart a new course.
